zh: 新增插件更新提醒：每天自动检查，优先 Gitee，GitHub 备用。
画图按钮旁可查看新版本、更新说明和 DSH 兼容性，复制安装地址或忽略此版本。
提供手动检查和插件管理器入口；检查失败不影响生图，不自动安装。
en: Adds daily update checks with Gitee first and GitHub as fallback.
Shows new versions, release notes and DSH compatibility beside Draw, with install links and an ignore option.
Includes manual checks and plugin manager navigation; failures do not block image creation, and updates are never installed automatically.
